# Starters that were ALREADY broken when the PE-140 clean-install check landed.
#
# A failure against a manifest listed here is reported as a ::warning:: instead
# of an ::error::, so the lane is green on day one and a NEW breakage is
# unambiguous. Every line owes a ticket. This file only ever shrinks: do not add
# to it to make a change pass, fix the starter.
#
# Format, one entry per line:
#   <starter>|<manifest path relative to the repo root>|<why, and the ticket>
#
# Matching is on the first two fields, so a listed manifest is exempt for every
# problem it reports, not just the one seen on 2026-09-17. That is the cost of
# keeping the list short, and it is also why the list has to shrink.

a2a-a2ui|examples/integrations/a2a-a2ui/package.json|`next build` fails typechecking the scaffolded copilotkit:intelligence block in src/app/api/copilotkit/[[...slug]]/route.ts against the pinned @copilotkit/runtime 1.61.0: the conditional spread produces `apiUrl?: string | undefined` where CopilotKitIntelligenceConfig wants `string`. Same block, same error, in agent-spec. Every other starter carries the identical block but sets `typescript.ignoreBuildErrors: true`, which is why only these two show it. PE-140 follow-up (intelligence scaffold types).
agent-spec|examples/integrations/agent-spec/package.json|Same scaffolded copilotkit:intelligence type error as a2a-a2ui above. PE-140 follow-up (intelligence scaffold types).
